context: A method for producing Si, characterized in that it comprises adding, to an SiO solid, an oxide, a hydroxide, a carbonate or a fluoride of an alkali metal element, or an oxide, a hydroxide, a carbonate or a fluoride of an alkaline earth metal element, or two or more of the above-mentioned compounds in a total molar amount of 1/20 to 1000 times that of the SiO solid to prepare a mixture, heating the mixture to a temperature from the melting point of Si to 2000 ° C, to effect a reaction for forming Si, and separating the resulting Si from reaction by-products for recovery. The method can be used for producing Si, at a low cost with good efficiency, from SiO solids in various forms which are formed in a Si production process and the like and have conventionally had no industrial value.

A method of machining a semiconductor wafer-use polishing pad, capable forming grooves, recesses and through holes having an inner surface roughness as small as up to 20 μm, a high dimension accuracy, and a uniform sectional shape; and a semiconductor wafer-use polishing pad. The machining method machines by cutting the polishing surface of a polishing pad having a non-water-soluble matrix containing a cross-linking polymer, and water-soluble particles dispersed in the non-water-soluble matrix. During the machining, it is preferable that the polishing pad be mounted on one surface side of a machining table having a suction hole and sucked from the other surface side of the table to suck and fixed the pad to the one surface side of the table, and then a groove or the like is formed.

An automobile engine valve mechanism system shim or lifter that slides with a cam lobe on a cam shaft as a mating member, for driving internal combustion engine intake and exhaust valves is disclosed. The surface that slides with the cam lobe as a mating member is coated with a hard carbon thin film, which has a surface hardness, measured in Knoop hardness, of 1500-4500 kg/mm2, a film thickness of 0.3-2.0 μm, and a surface roughness (Ry) [μm] that satisfies the relation Ry < {(0.75 - Hk/8000) × h + 0.07/0.8} ...(A)(h in the expression is the thickness of the hard carbon thin film, in [μm], and Hk is the Knoop hardness of the hard carbon thin film, in [kg/mm2]. There are provided an automobile engine valve mechanism system shim, lifter and a cam shaft combination, superior in friction characteristics and durability, inhibiting film cracking, peeling or the like that occurs when hard thin films, which are considered to have less ductility, are applied to sliding parts, securing durability and reliability, realizing a low friction coefficient.

An incubator (1) and a culture device capable of reducing contamination by dirt and bacteria in each treatment process with a simple structure, the incubator (1) wherein a culture medium container (3) having culture medium sealed therein and a waste culture medium container (4) capable of storing fluid in a main culture container (2) are connected to the main culture medium container (2), in the sealed state to the outside, through connection pipes (5) and (6) capable of limiting the flow of the fluid therebetween, and the inside volumes of the containers (2), (3), and (4) are made variable; the culture device comprising a case having recessed parts for storing the containers (2), (3), and (4) and a pressing means for contracting the containers in the recessed parts by applying an external force thereto.
